$TOOLS_MIX = "/usr/bin/true"
$TOOLS_TRACEROUTE = "/usr/bin/true"
$clock=0
$trace_execs=0
$progress=0
$final=nil
function fixture_monotonic() return $clock end
function fixture_sleep($seconds)
  global $clock
  $clock=$clock+$seconds
end
function fixture_run_argv($argv,$opts)
  global $clock,$trace_execs
  if $argv[1] == "-c" then
    if $opts.timeout != 5 or $opts.max_output != 4096 or not $opts.clear_env then raise("TEST","resolver bound") end
    $clock=$clock+1
    return {ok:env("TRACE_CASE") != "resolver_timeout",stdout:env("TRACE_IPS")}
  end
  if not $opts.clear_env or $opts.timeout > 8 or $opts.timeout > 60-$clock or $opts.max_output != 4096 or $argv[9] != "9.9.9.9" then raise("TEST","trace argv/deadline") end
  $trace_execs=$trace_execs+1
  $clock=$clock+(if env("TRACE_CASE") == "hops" then 0.1 else $opts.timeout end)
  $target=if env("TRACE_CASE") == "hops" then "8.8.8.8" else "9.9.9.9" end
  return {ok:true,stdout:to_string($trace_execs) .. " " .. $target .. " 1 ms\n"}
end
function fixture_http_post($url,$body,$headers,$opts)
  global $clock,$progress,$final
  $b=json_parse($body)
  if $b.seq != nil then
    if $opts.timeout > 15 or $opts.timeout > 60-$clock then raise("TEST","progress deadline") end
    $progress=$progress+1
    if env("TRACE_CASE") == "deadline" then
      $clock=$clock+$opts.timeout
      return {status:500}
    end
    return {status:200}
  end
  if $opts.timeout != 20 then raise("TEST","final report bound") end
  $final=$b
  return {status:200}
end
